node.title: Encoding all HTML entities except < and >
node.author: TrixieTang
node.doctext: How would one go about encoding all HTML entities in a string except for < and >? I've tried using HTML::Entities, but it ends up encoding < and > and breaking the HTML. I've also tried tinkering with the unsafe_characters parameter in HTML::Entities but I still can't seem to get it to allow < and >.
